$comment: The one definition of every NATS store Kubemoot creates: what it holds, whether it can hold people's data, who owns the data, and where a crew's share of it lives. The dashboard's NATS page reads this file. nats-stores.test.ts fails when docs/operating/data-ownership.md or the operator chart's nats-streams-job.yaml disagrees with it, so the three cannot drift. peoplesData: yes, derived (written by a model from people's data), maybe (only if someone replays real questions), no. owner: crew (keyed by the crew's namespace and name), system-learning (state about models, servers and tools, no question text), kubemoot (the platform's own working state). crewKey: where a crew's share lives; {ns} and {crew} are the crew's namespace and name. A store with no crewKey is not keyed by crew. defaultMaxBytes is the bootstrap job's size limit in bytes, or null when a chart value sets it. namespaceKey, on the stores a namespace-scoped dashboard serves, is the key pattern of one namespace's share, so a scoped dashboard shows its namespaces' share of the store and not the cluster-wide totals. createdBy: liaison for a store the crew liaison creates itself when its feature is on (not the bootstrap job); absent means the bootstrap job.

stores.name: KUBEMOOT_DISCUSS
stores.holds: Every message of every discussion: the question, each agent's finding and reason, the synthesis, the closing receipt

stores.name: KUBEMOOT_COORDINATOR
stores.holds: Each coordinator's decision log per thread, including the question, the brief and the synthesis

stores.name: KUBEMOOT_REQUEST
stores.holds: Questions waiting for a crew to pick them up, with the requester's time zone and local time

stores.name: KUBEMOOT_CHAT
stores.holds: Direct chat exchanges: the question cut to 500 characters, the answer cut to 2000

stores.name: KUBEMOOT_OPERATOR
stores.holds: Onboarding progress of MCP servers

stores.name: KUBEMOOT_CHRONICLE
stores.holds: MCP server verdicts and trials

stores.name: KUBEMOOT_QUALITY
stores.holds: Reserved for quality events; nothing writes to it today

stores.name: kubemoot_conversations
stores.holds: Earlier turns of each conversation (question and answer per turn), for follow-up questions

stores.name: kubemoot_crew_memory
stores.holds: Facts a crew learned, written by a model from conversations and tool results

stores.name: kubemoot_scheduled
stores.holds: Reminders and follow-ups an agent scheduled, with their text; a record is deleted when it fires

stores.name: kubemoot_scheduler_performance
stores.holds: What the scheduler observed per model server, model and agent

stores.name: kubemoot_crew_resumes
stores.holds: What each crew's agents and skills offer

stores.name: kubemoot_server_state
stores.holds: A ModelServer's probed capacity

stores.name: kubemoot_latency
stores.holds: Evaluation latencies per server

stores.name: kubemoot_model_demand
stores.holds: Which models crews wait for or used recently

stores.name: kubemoot_server_tickets
stores.holds: Per-call reservations of accelerator memory

stores.name: kubemoot_agent_state
stores.holds: Agent heartbeats

stores.name: kubemoot_coordinator_leases
stores.holds: Which coordinator owns a thread (created only with coordinator.lease)

stores.name: kubemoot_placement_leader
stores.holds: The placement service's leader lease

stores.name: kubemoot_workspace
stores.holds: Tool results and contributions agents spill during a thread, stored as the tool returned them

stores.name: kubemoot_fitness_artifacts
stores.holds: Fitness result spreadsheets and per-iteration transcripts

stores.name: kubemoot_liaison_door
stores.holds: The door's single-use marks, sealed: which codes and refresh tokens it has seen

stores.name: kubemoot_liaison_accounts
stores.holds: A person's connected accounts, sealed
